context: M28 o7. (Nick.) Herald Square. Nick walks through the crowd to Odessa. People recognise him. The noise drops.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Mrs. Pruitt. I'm Nikos Varelas. My name is on your building.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: So you're the paper. You're shorter than the paper.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: I bought a building. Nobody told me there were people in it.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Somebody's telling you now. Two hundred people. One radio. One dead seaman.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: May I walk with you, Mrs. Pruitt? I'm not good at it. I'll learn.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Slowly, Mr. Varelas. Let them see you.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: …I'm sorry. I'm sorry for your seaman.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Sorry is a short word, Mr. Varelas. Try a longer one by Friday.

lines.speaker: npc.marcher
lines.text: Who owns the Tenderloin? We do!
